tickets.title: Prepare life insurance coverage analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a life insurance coverage analysis for Alina and Derek Mossbutton reflecting Nora's adoption, Derek's reduced household income during his unpaid leave from Velvet Acorn Pediatrics, the $412,000 mortgage balance, and current group and term policies (Alina's employer group life equal to one times salary and Derek's $250,000 term policy with Moonbadger Life through 2041).
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare life insurance coverage analysis by 2026-03-09 reflecting Nora’s adoption, Derek’s reduced household income during leave, the mortgage balance, and current group and term policies.

tickets.title: Care Cost Planning Starter

Show reserve impact, dependent-care reimbursements, and possible education account funding levels.
